quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常会在留出的测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1][p2]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常会在留出的测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1][p2]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 作者指出，过拟合的原因是特征检测器被调整成在训练数据上协同工作良好，但在测试数据上则不然 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出 dropout 方法：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，以 0.5 的概率随机将每个隐藏单元从网络中省略，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“平均网络” [p5]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We then applied dropout to TIMIT, a widely used benchmark for recognition of clean speech with a small vocabulary.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: These images were labeled by hand to produce 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures
claim: 对于语音和两个物体识别数据集，作者通过留出的验证集来选择网络架构，再用在验证集上表现最好的架构评估 dropout 在真实测试集上的性能 [p12]。

quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，不使用 dropout 的识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息方法的纪录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误率，在第六个隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set. This is reduced to 29.62% by using 50% dropout
claim: 在 Reuters 上，使用 50% dropout 将错误率从 31.05% 降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，会出现退化问题——随着深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层会导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型的训练误差不应高于其较浅对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不期望每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标底层映射 H(x)，而是显式地让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重铸为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections” (Fig. 2).
claim: 该形式通过前馈神经网络的“快捷连接”实现，快捷连接执行恒等映射，其输出加到堆叠层的输出上，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。

quote: But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical, and thus $W_{s}$ is only used when matching dimensions.
claim: 当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济，因此 W_s 仅在匹配维度时使用 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation, following.
claim: 训练设置包括：随机采样短边在 [256,480] 的图像、224×224 裁剪、逐像素均值减法、标准颜色增强、每个卷积后激活前使用批归一化、SGD 小批量 256、学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10、训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 此外在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行研究，使用简单架构，网络输入 32×32 图像，堆叠 6n 层 3×3 卷积，特征图大小分别为 {32,16,8}，滤波器数分别为 {16,32,64}，所有情况使用恒等快捷连接 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: The network inputs are 32 $\times$ 32 images, with the per-pixel mean subtracted.
claim: 此外在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行研究，使用简单架构，网络输入 32×32 图像，堆叠 6n 层 3×3 卷积，特征图大小分别为 {32,16,8}，滤波器数分别为 {16,32,64}，所有情况使用恒等快捷连接 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且在整个训练过程中训练误差都更高，呈现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: First, the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
claim: 使用残差学习后情况反转：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且训练误差显著更低并能泛化到验证数据 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: Second, compared to its plain counterpart, the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error (Fig. 4 right vs. left).
claim: 与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，优于所有先前集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth, and exhibit higher training error when going deeper.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，普通网络随深度增加训练误差升高，而 ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，普通网络随深度增加训练误差升高，而 ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
claim: 1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者表示本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: We conjecture that the deep plain nets may have exponentially low convergence rates, which impact the reducing of the training error
claim: 此外，作者提到深度普通网络可能存在指数级低的收敛速率，影响训练误差的降低，这种优化困难的原因将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
claim: 作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 其核心是缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 得到权重，再对 value 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]；

quote: $\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}(\frac{QK^{T}}{\sqrt{d_{k}}})V$
claim: 其核心是缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 得到权重，再对 value 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]；

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 模型使用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头维度为 64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: To this end, we add "positional encodings" to the input embeddings at the bottoms of the encoder and decoder stacks.
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p3]。

quote: $\displaystyle PE_{(pos,2i)}=sin(pos/10000^{2i/d_{\text{model}}})$
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p3]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）[S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
claim: 此外，作者在 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分（约 40K 训练句）以及约 17M 句的半监督设置下进行了英语成分句法分析实验 [S6.SS3.p2]。

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$.
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（含集成）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 的新 state-of-the-art [S6.SS1.p1]；

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model.
claim: 在英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于所有此前已发表的单模型，训练成本不到此前 state-of-the-art 模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar.
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，尽管缺少任务特定调参，模型表现优于此前所有报告模型，仅逊于 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [S6.SS3.p4]，并且在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，尽管缺少任务特定调参，模型表现优于此前所有报告模型，仅逊于 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [S6.SS3.p4]，并且在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 消融实验显示单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]，减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality.
claim: 消融实验显示单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]，减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
claim: 作者指出，将注意力加权位置进行平均会降低有效分辨率，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在大小为 r 的邻域内，但这会把最大路径长度增加到 O(n/r)，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以访问和精确操作知识，性能落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策依据和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 作者希望将参数化与非参数化记忆的混合模型从抽取式任务扩展到序列到序列生成模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART-large），将检索文档视为隐变量进行端到端训练 [S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART-large），将检索文档视为隐变量进行端到端训练 [S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ（BART-large），将检索文档视为隐变量进行端到端训练 [S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
claim: 作者提出两种边缘化方式：RAG-Sequence 对整个序列使用同一文档，RAG-Token 允许每个 token 使用不同文档 [S2.p2]。

quote: We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
claim: 训练时联合训练检索器与生成器，不直接监督应检索哪个文档，并固定文档编码器与索引，仅微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 所有实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 21M 文档，并用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时的 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 实验覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 实验覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.
claim: 实验覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 实验覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: 在四个开放域问答任务上 RAG 均取得新的最优结果（TQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: RAG can generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not in any retrieved document, achieving 11.8% accuracy in such cases for NQ, where an extractive model would score 0%.
claim: RAG 在正确答案不在任何检索文档中时仍能达到 11.8% 的 NQ 准确率，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART 的 Q-BLEU-1；人工评估中 RAG 更符合事实的比例为 42.7%，BART 仅 7.1% [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: 在 FEVER 上，三分类结果与最优模型相差 4.3% 以内，且不使用检索监督 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
claim: RAG 生成比 BART 更多样，且可通过替换非参数记忆更新知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1][S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.
claim: RAG 生成比 BART 更多样，且可通过替换非参数记忆更新知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1][S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在故事生成等任务中检索组件可能“崩溃”，总是检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: FEVER 的另一个子任务（抽取证据句）因 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump 而难以直接处理，作者希望在未来工作中解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
claim: 此外，作者尝试的 Null document 机制未带来性能提升，因此为简单起见被省略 [A6.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning: to achieve strong performance on a desired task typically requires fine-tuning on a dataset of thousands to hundreds of thousands of examples specific to that task.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定任务的标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: Here we show that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令就能完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统在这方面仍存在困难 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令就能完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统在这方面仍存在困难 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: Here we show that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
claim: 因此，论文测试扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model, which we call GPT-3, and measuring its in-context learning abilities.
claim: 因此，论文测试扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters, with the last being the model we call GPT-3.
claim: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大模型称为 GPT-3 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters, with the last being the model we call GPT-3.
claim: GPT-3 沿用 GPT-2 的模型和架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: For all tasks, GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.
claim: 评估时，GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”, or in-context learning where we allow as many demonstrations as will fit into the model’s context window (typically 10 to 100), (b) “one-shot learning”, where we allow only one demonstration, and (c) “zero-shot” learning, where no demonstrations are allowed and only an instruction in natural language is given to the model.
claim: 论文在零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置下评估，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

quote: We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100 as this is how many examples can fit in the model’s context window
claim: 论文在零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置下评估，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation to tasks unlikely to be directly contained in the training set.
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3 [S1.p9]。

quote: In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks and tasks that are similar to language modeling, such as Cloze tasks and sentence/paragraph completion tasks.
claim: 评估覆盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成任务等类别 [S3.p3]。

quote: We also undertake a systematic study of “data contamination”
claim: 此外，论文还系统研究了数据污染问题，构建了清理后的基准子集来量化其影响 [S1.p15][S4.p5]。

quote: For each benchmark, we produce a ‘clean’ version which removes all potentially leaked examples
claim: 此外，论文还系统研究了数据污染问题，构建了清理后的基准子集来量化其影响 [S1.p15][S4.p5]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art (despite state-of-the-art being held by fine-tuned models).
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置有时可与或偶尔超过此前最优的微调模型 [S1.p11]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art (despite state-of-the-art being held by fine-tuned models).
claim: 例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 81.5 F1，单样本 84.0 F1，少样本 85.0 F1 [S1.p11]；

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art (despite state-of-the-art being held by fine-tuned models).
claim: 在 TriviaQA 上，零样本 64.3%，单样本 68.0%，少样本 71.2%，后者在相同闭卷设置下相对微调模型达到最优 [S1.p11]。

quote: GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning
claim: GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，并能生成让人类评估者难以与人类文章区分的合成新闻文章 [S1.p12]。

quote: we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
claim: 同时，论文发现少样本性能在部分任务上仍然困难，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves, and occasionally contain non-sequitur sentences or paragraphs.
claim: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如在文档级别语义重复、长段落失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves, and occasionally contain non-sequitur sentences or paragraphs.
claim: GPT-3 在“常识物理”问题上似乎特别困难，并且在部分“比较”任务（如 WiC 和 ANLI）以及部分阅读理解任务上，单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising.
claim: 作者还指出，论文只使用自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲部分任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。

quote: Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training.
claim: 此外，预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是从头学习还是识别已见任务存在不确定性，以及大模型推理昂贵且不便，都是作者明确承认的局限 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training.
claim: 此外，预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是从头学习还是识别已见任务存在不确定性，以及大模型推理昂贵且不便，都是作者明确承认的局限 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form.
claim: 此外，预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是从头学习还是识别已见任务存在不确定性，以及大模型推理昂贵且不便，都是作者明确承认的局限 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力模式 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力模式 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，以及此前视觉自注意力方法因使用专门注意力模式而难以在现代硬件加速器上有效扩展 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，以及此前视觉自注意力方法因使用专门注意力模式而难以在现代硬件加速器上有效扩展 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: To handle 2D images, we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
claim: 方法上，ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 为进行分类，模型在序列前加入一个可学习的分类 token，其编码器输出状态作为图像表示 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
claim: 模型设计尽量贴近原始 Transformer，只使用标准可学习的一维位置嵌入，并可在微调时对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值以适应更高分辨率 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We use standard learnable 1D position embeddings, since we have not observed significant performance gains from using more advanced 2D-aware position embeddings
claim: 模型设计尽量贴近原始 Transformer，只使用标准可学习的一维位置嵌入，并可在微调时对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值以适应更高分辨率 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We therefore perform 2D interpolation of the pre-trained position embeddings, according to their location in the original image.
claim: 模型设计尽量贴近原始 Transformer，只使用标准可学习的一维位置嵌入，并可在微调时对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值以适应更高分辨率 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与图像块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization, and used standardized convolutions.
claim: 基线为使用 Group Normalization 和标准化卷积的 ResNet（BiT），混合模型则把 CNN 特征图输入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096 and apply a high weight decay of $0.1$
claim: 训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、高权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
claim: 在中型数据集如 ImageNet 上无强正则化训练时，ViT 的准确率比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点 [S1.p4]。

quote: the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
claim: 但在更大数据集（14M–300M 图像）上预训练后，ViT 接近或超过当时最优结果：最佳模型在 ImageNet 达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 达到 90.72%、CIFAR-100 达到 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务套件达到 77.63% [S1.p5]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 较小的 ViT-L/16 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后，在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且训练计算资源显著更少 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
claim: 在性能与计算权衡上，ViT 达到相同性能所需计算约为 ResNet 的 2–4 倍更少，混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距在更大模型上消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: Vision Transformers overfit more than ResNets with comparable computational cost on smaller datasets.
claim: 作者指出，ViT 在较小数据集上比同计算量的 ResNet 更容易过拟合，卷积归纳偏置对较小数据集有用 [S4.SS3.p3]。

quote: our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
claim: 自监督预训练方面，ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4%，自监督与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S4.SS6.p1][S5.p2]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 自监督预训练方面，ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4%，自监督与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S4.SS6.p1][S5.p2]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 作者还指出，将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他视觉任务仍是待解决的挑战，进一步扩展 ViT 可能带来性能提升 [S5.p2]。

quote: do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答“林肯的生日是什么”这类问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（即作弊/数据污染），还是真正学会了从维基百科等来源中提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: These studies use models pretrained on internet data, leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer (traditional memorization / data contamination).
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答“林肯的生日是什么”这类问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（即作弊/数据污染），还是真正学会了从维基百科等来源中提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.

quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的 agent，可与计算机交互解决真实软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。

quote: We use two approaches to enhance performance on a development set: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: 相比 Lite 上的 RAG，SWE-agent 成本高 8–13 倍，但 % Resolved 率提升 6.7 倍；相比同样使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 Shell-only，相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。

quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices

quote: All that is necessary for linear attention to be fast is for L to be a structured matrix

claim: 进一步，作者证明标量恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶，具有相同的线性与二次形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。

quote: we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
claim: 基于此，作者提出SSD算法，对半可分矩阵进行块分解，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用低秩结构归约为更小的递归 [S6.p4]。

quote: We compare on a challenging version of the MQAR setup from, using a harder task, longer sequences, and smaller models.

quote: This implies that when $D/N$ is sufficiently large, or $P_{\text{post}}$ sufficiently small, loss after quantization can increase as models are pretrained for longer
claim: 后训练量化的损失退化随训练数据量增加而增大，对于固定模型，当 D/N 足够大或量化精度足够低时，额外的预训练数据反而会增加量化后的损失 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS1.p3]。

quote: The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
claim: 训练时量化权重、激活和 KV 缓存的效果可建模为独立且乘性的，共同影响有效参数量 [S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: which reveals that in general the optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute budget.
claim: 当联合优化 N、D、P 时，计算最优的预训练精度与计算预算无关，拟合结果约为 7-8 位；但当模型大小 N 固定时，计算最优精度随计算预算对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p1]。

quote: our scaling laws predict that models of differing sizes should not necessarily be trained in the same precision, and that compute-optimal precision scales as $P^{*}(C)\propto\log C$.
claim: 当联合优化 N、D、P 时，计算最优的预训练精度与计算预算无关，拟合结果约为 7-8 位；但当模型大小 N 固定时，计算最优精度随计算预算对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p1]。

quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
claim: 计算成本虽随精度线性缩放，但由于系统开销，减半精度带来的收益通常不到 2 倍 [S6.p2]。

claim: 论文旨在进一步推动开源模型能力边界，通过扩大模型规模并引入 DeepSeek-V3 来缩小与闭源模型的差距 [S1.p1]。

quote: With a forward-looking perspective, we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs.
claim: 同时，作者希望在保持强模型性能的同时实现经济成本，因此继续采用 MLA 和 DeepSeekMoE，并额外引入无辅助损失负载均衡与多 token 预测目标 [S1.p2]。

quote: The basic architecture of DeepSeek-V3 is still within the Transformer framework.
claim: DeepSeek-V3 的基本架构仍处于 Transformer 框架内，采用 MLA 进行高效推理、DeepSeekMoE 进行经济训练，并额外引入无辅助损失负载均衡策略 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: The core of MLA is the low-rank joint compression for attention keys and values to reduce Key-Value (KV) cache during inference
claim: MLA 的核心是对注意力 key 和 value 进行低秩联合压缩，以减少推理时的 KV cache [S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Compared with traditional MoE architectures like GShard, DeepSeekMoE uses finer-grained experts and isolates some experts as shared ones.
claim: DeepSeekMoE 使用更细粒度专家并隔离部分共享专家，DeepSeek-V3 使用 sigmoid 计算亲和度并对选中的亲和度分数归一化 [S2.SS1.SSS2.Px1.p1]。

quote: Inspired by, we investigate and set a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) objective for DeepSeek-V3, which extends the prediction scope to multiple future tokens at each position.
claim: 此外，模型设置多 token 预测目标，使用 D 个顺序模块预测额外 token，并保持每个预测深度的完整因果链 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: To be specific, our MTP implementation uses $D$ sequential modules to predict $D$ additional tokens.
claim: 此外，模型设置多 token 预测目标，使用 D 个顺序模块预测额外 token，并保持每个预测深度的完整因果链 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: DeepSeek-V3 is trained on a cluster equipped with 2048 NVIDIA H800 GPUs.

claim: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多样 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段 YaRN 将上下文从 4K 扩展到 32K 再到 128K [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1][S4.SS3.p1]。

claim: 其基础模型在多数基准上取得最佳表现，尤其在数学和代码任务上 [S4.T3]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 作者认为测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证，但复现工作依赖大规模强化学习或海量样本 [S1.p1]。

quote: We collect an initial 59,029 questions from 16 sources following three guiding principles.
claim: 方法分两部分：数据方面，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 道题，用 Gemini Flash Thinking 生成推理轨迹，再按质量、难度、多样性三阶段筛选出 1,000 条 s1K [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: Thus, we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
claim: 方法分两部分：数据方面，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 道题，用 Gemini Flash Thinking 生成推理轨迹，再按质量、难度、多样性三阶段筛选出 1,000 条 s1K [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: We perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of an off-the-shelf pretrained model on our small dataset requiring just 26 minutes of training on 16 H100 GPUs.
claim: 训练方面，在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上做监督微调，仅用 16 张 H100 训练 26 分钟 [S1.p2][S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。
训练方面，在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上做监督微调，仅用 16 张 H100 训练 26 分钟 [S1.p2][S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 测试时使用 budget forcing：超过上限时强制插入思考结束符提前退出，想延长时抑制结束符并追加“Wait”鼓励反思 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 评估使用三个基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），基于 lm-evaluation-harness，温度 0 贪心解码，测准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series
claim: 对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: Only Quality (1K-random): After obtaining our high-quality reasoning chains from Gemini, we select 1,000 samples at random
claim: 消融实验分别检验数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.
claim: 消融实验分别检验数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24），并通过 budget forcing 将 AIME24 从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。

quote: We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
claim: 它是样本效率最高的开放数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 条样本就显著优于基座 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融显示，随机选择、仅多样性或仅最长轨迹都明显更差（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而全量 59K 相比 1K 没有实质增益 [S1.p3]。

quote: Overall, we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.
claim: 测试时扩展方面，budget forcing 具有完美可控性、正斜率且取得最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: 作者明确承认 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，过度抑制思考结束符可能使模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
claim: 作者还指出，能否仅用 1,000 条样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 作者指出，传统范式基于两个假设——掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
claim: 作者认为这种数据密集型范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型在预训练中已包含大量数学内容，挑战已从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

quote: In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
claim: 论文提出 LIMO 假说，认为在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范涌现，其两个前提是模型参数中存在潜在前置知识，以及推理链能将复杂问题分解为详细逻辑步骤 [S3.p1]。

quote: Starting with a corpus of tens of millions of mathematical problems, we first applied a baseline difficulty filter using a short-CoT mathematical model, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct.
claim: 作者据此构建 LIMO 数据集：从数千万数学问题出发，先用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 过滤简单题，再用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 采样 32 次，保留仅成功 1–3 次的问题，得到 2,125 题的 LIMO-Pool [S3.SS1.SSS1.p3]。

quote: we employed three state-of-the-art reasoning models—DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and QwQ-32B —sampling multiple solutions from each to generate diverse reasoning approaches.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出每题最高分解答，取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we implemented a rule-based scoring system that calculated weighted metrics for each dimension.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出每题最高分解答，取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出每题最高分解答，取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
claim: 训练上，作者对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3、FlashAttention-2、学习率 5.0e-6、余弦衰减、无 warmup、15 个 epoch、batch size 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并设置分布外评估，包括 OlympiadBench、中文新构建的 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并设置分布外评估，包括 OlympiadBench、中文新构建的 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1，较大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview
claim: 基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型，所有对比实验使用相同 LLM backbone [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples
claim: 基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型，所有对比实验使用相同 LLM backbone [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: We collect and categorize these solutions into five distinct quality levels (L1-L5, with L5 being the highest)
claim: 分析实验还比较了不同推理链质量 L1–L5、不同问题难度 Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500、不同预训练模型 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、不同模型规模 3B–72B，以及 400 到 2,000 条样本的数据规模 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We select three sets of 500 problems with increasing difficulty: Simple-500 (MATH levels 1-2), Complex-500 (MATH levels 3-5), and Advanced-500 (AIME problems).
claim: 分析实验还比较了不同推理链质量 L1–L5、不同问题难度 Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500、不同预训练模型 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、不同模型规模 3B–72B，以及 400 到 2,000 条样本的数据规模 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we compare two 32B-parameter models: Qwen1.5-32B-Chat and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (LIMO’s base model).
claim: 分析实验还比较了不同推理链质量 L1–L5、不同问题难度 Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500、不同预训练模型 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、不同模型规模 3B–72B，以及 400 到 2,000 条样本的数据规模 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we fine-tune models from the Qwen2.5-Instruct series of varying sizes—3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B—using the LIMO dataset with 800 high-quality samples.
claim: 分析实验还比较了不同推理链质量 L1–L5、不同问题难度 Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500、不同预训练模型 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、不同模型规模 3B–72B，以及 400 到 2,000 条样本的数据规模 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we select top-ranked subsets of varying sizes—400, 800, 1,200, 1,600, and 2,000 questions—to construct five datasets (LIMO-400 through LIMO-2k).
claim: 分析实验还比较了不同推理链质量 L1–L5、不同问题难度 Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500、不同预训练模型 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、不同模型规模 3B–72B，以及 400 到 2,000 条样本的数据规模 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
claim: LIMO 在域内任务上取得最佳结果：AIME24 达 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；MATH500 达 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；AMC23 达 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达 67.6%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座模型的 45.3%；CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；GPQA 达 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 显著退化至 32.3%，低于基座模型的 49.9%，OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能最高，为 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: L5-trained models achieve highest results on both AIME24 and MATH500, with performance decreasing consistently with each quality level.
claim: 分析显示，推理链质量越高性能越好，L5 训练模型在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；

quote: modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
claim: 仅改变问题难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 准确率提升，达到 51.5%，Advanced-500 训练的模型在 MATH500 上达 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；

quote: LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
claim: 预训练模型选择影响显著，LIMO 在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点，在 MATH500 上高 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；

quote: The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
claim: 模型规模增大时 AIME24 从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异很小（95.6% vs. 94.8%），AIME24 上为 63.3% vs. 68.3%，可能存在饱和点 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；

quote: Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
claim: 仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升至 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升至 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
claim: 作者指出，尽管 800 个样本即可激发竞赛级数学推理，但维持有效性能的数据量下界仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 此外，作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 论文指出当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的整体架构由大语言模型、视觉编码器和基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: we introduce windowed attention in most layers, which ensures that computational cost scales linearly with the number of patches rather than quadratically.
claim: 在大多数层中使用窗口注意力，使计算成本随 patch 数量线性增长而非二次增长，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL incorporates dynamic frame rate (FPS) training and absolute time encoding.
claim: 模型还引入动态 FPS 采样和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL introduces a key improvement: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time.
claim: 模型还引入动态 FPS 采样和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
claim: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等最先进模型进行对比 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We evaluated our models across a diverse range of OCR, chart, and document understanding benchmarks.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL’s grounding capabilities on the referring expression comprehension benchmarks, object detection in the wild, self-curated point grounding benchmark, and CountBench.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We assessed our models across a diverse range of video understanding and grounding tasks, utilizing benchmarks that include videos ranging from a few seconds to several hours in length.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We assess the agent capabilities of Qwen2.5-VL through various aspects.
